definitions: A specific edition or rendition of something (e.g., a product, song, or story) that is made available only to a limited group or through a particular channel, often with unique features or content.
A variant of an item or content that is restricted in its distribution or access, typically for promotional or special release purposes.
examples: The band released an exclusive version of their album for fan club members.
This video game console comes with an exclusive version of the popular racing game.
She managed to get her hands on the exclusive version of the comic book, which included bonus artwork.
